question: How do I submit my own pet care tip?
answer: You can submit your pet care tip by going to the 'Add Tip' section in the app. Fill in the details like the type of pet, care instructions, and upload a photo. Once reviewed, your tip will be published.

question: Are the pet care tips free to access?
answer: Yes! All pet care tips in our app are free to browse, save, and share. Some premium features (like vet chat or ad-free experience) may require a subscription.

question: Can I save tips to view offline?
answer: Absolutely. Just tap the Save icon on any tip, and it will be available in your 'Saved Tips' even without internet access.

question: How do I filter tips by pet type or needs?
answer: Use the filter option on the home or search page to narrow tips by pet type (dog, cat, bird, etc.) or needs like grooming, training, nutrition, or health care.

question: Is there a supply list feature?
answer: Yes! When viewing any tip, you can tap 'Add to Supply List' and it will auto-generate a list of recommended items or supplies you may need.
